subject: Re: Subprocessor provenance + roles / certification Q&A
messages:
From: Ana Morales <ana@curewell.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: CureWell Security <security@curewell.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor provenance and roles - certification window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our upcoming third-party risk review (SOC 2 bridge), we need a compact mapping of Redwood's current inference-related subprocessors and a short explanation of custody / role responsibilities for each provider. Specifically CureWell needs:

- A CSV roster with: subprocessor name, service provided, region of processing (onshore/offshore), whether they hold KMS keys or have access to plaintext, and an assigned on-call contact at Redwood.
- A short provenance note for any provider that performs persistent storage or key custody (where the data flows originate and whether data is transformed/pseudonymized).
- Any planned changes in the next 90 days (decommissions, new onshore mirrors, escrow handoffs).

We have a deadline to bundle evidence to our auditors by 2025-09-02. If you can share the roster + any control artifacts (KMS proof points, attestations) by EOD 2025-08-23 we can slot them in.

Also: will you be able to commit to a 30-minute call next week to walk the auditor through the KMS pathing?

Appreciate it,

Ana Morales
Senior Security Manager
CureWell Health

P.S. Please attach any lightweight artifacts only (no full logs) — we will provide a secure upload link if required.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Ana Morales <ana@curewell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor provenance and roles - certification window

Ana — thanks, will do. Attaching a first-pass CSV roster and a KMS provenance matrix (high level) for your intake. Notes up front:

- The roster is scoped to inference runtime & telemetry partners (we excluded payroll/HR vendors).
- For providers that hold encrypted customer material we indicate whether keys are customer-managed, Redwood-managed in a KMS, or third-party-managed.
- We include onshore residency flags and a contact for each integration owner.

Ben and Markus: can you confirm the KMS custody lines and the escrow/handback timeline for the two providers in row 4/5 of the roster? Also flag any planned infra moves in the next 90 days.

Next steps for CureWell: if the artifacts look sufficient we can upload them to your secure intake link; otherwise we can prepare a minimal attestation PDF signed by our security lead.

Call availability: I can do 2025-08-25 between 09:00-12:00 PT — please let me know what works.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Product Security (GTM)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_roster_20250821.csv (CSV), kms_provenance_matrix_20250821.xlsx (Excel)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor provenance and roles - certification window

Kim — quick clarifications inline for the roster rows you flagged: 

- Row 4 (Nimbus GPU scheduling): keys are Redwood-managed in our primary KMS (AWS KMS in us-west-2). No plaintext access by the vendor; they operate over encrypted artifacts and a short-lived ephemeral token for session orchestration.
- Row 5 (EdgeCache storage): currently third-party-managed encryption for archival snapshots in an EU mirror. We're migrating to an onshore mirror (us-east-1) and plan to complete the migration by 2025-09-18.

I've attached a one-page escrow/control matrix that lists the handback triggers and the escrow provider contact. The provider oncall path is the same as our infra-runbook: team infra-oncall -> infra-leads -> security-sre. See oncall_and_escalation_paths.txt.

Ben Carter
Vendor Risk Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: escrow_control_matrix_v1.pdf, oncall_and_escalation_paths.txt

Kim, Ben — this is helpful, thank you. A couple of questions from our audit team after a quick pass:

- For Nimbus (row 4): can you confirm whether Redwood rotates the KMS CMKs and provide a statement on rotation cadence? A one-sentence statement is fine.
- For EdgeCache (row 5): the migration plan note is fine; please confirm whether archived snapshots are encrypted-at-rest with provider keys today (yes/no) and whether there is a migration cutover date we can reference in the bundle.

We'd also like a brief attestation from a Redwood security executive (name + title + date) that the roster is complete for the inference surface. If you can provide that attestation PDF and the CSV by EOD 2025-08-23 we'll be able to close the loop for the auditors.

We can do a 30-minute walkthrough on Mon 2025-08-25 at 10:00 AM PT — sending a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,

Ana

4) Upload / call: we'll place the CSV + KMS matrix + attestation + escrow matrix into the secure folder (link below) and accept your secure upload token if you prefer DocuSign packaging. I've penciled in the 25 Aug 10:00 AM PT call — please confirm and we'll send an invite.
